title: Paper bag: the agent rejects free fall
description: A crumpled paper bag thrown across a blackboard, filmed at 200 fps. The arc is lopsided, so free fall misses the held-out motion by 41% and is rejected; linear air drag predicts it, with a velocity time constant of 0.38 s.
credit: Video: Rhetos / Mathe-AC Lernwerkstatt, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (slow-motion part, trimmed)
